title: Multiplication by a compactly supported smooth function is a sequentially continuous linear map from 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) to 𝒟^k(U)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set and let ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ with compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ U. Then there is an ℝ-linear map M : 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) → 𝒟^k(U) (TestFormOn univ k →ₗ[ℝ] TestFormOn U k) with (Mω)(x) = ζ(x)·ω(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) and every x ∈ ℝ^P, such that for every sequence ω_j in 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) with ω_j → 0 in the test-form topology (TestFormOnConverges ω_j 0: one compact set contains all tsupport ω_j and every iterated derivative converges uniformly on it) we have Mω_j → 0 in 𝒟^k(U) (TestFormOnConverges (Mω_j) 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∃ M : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k →ₗ[ℝ] TestFormOn U k, (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (x : Euclid P), (M ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x = ζ x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∧ ∀ ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, TestFormOnConverges ωs 0 → TestFormOnConverges (fun j => M (ωs j)) 0
